classifications.basis: REPLACEABLE >=10m retry-safe owners are recovery-eligible, not live owners. The production compiler correctly counts those jobs as claimable recovery work. Corrected append-only oracle v1.1 supersedes v1.

The portfolio dedupe law says a terminal return for the same dedupe_key blocks replay. Production computeFrontierPressure indexes terminal returns and duplicate rows by job_id only, so a second job_id with the same terminal dedupe_key remains claimable. Existing compiler tests do not cover this cross-job dedupe_key case.
